title: CHG-3367: change to the Order Pipeline
body:
SUMMARY:

This memo records a change to the Order Pipeline that is
currently approved. It was raised by Rohan Mehta of Data
Services and touches 10 hosts behind the Order Pipeline, all
of them in the production estate.

DETAILS:

Together with Bluegate Networks the team plans the following
steps for the 03:30-05:00 UTC window:
* Rotate the database credentials used by the nightly batch
  jobs
* Move the nightly export to the new object store bucket
* Upgrade the message broker to the current long-term
  release

DECISION:

The change advisory board marks this change as approved.
Amara Osei filed this record on 6 January 2025 after the
board session of 24 October 2025; minutes are in the shared
archive.
